latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of linkedin-ads-cli skill.

- Provides read-only LinkedIn Ads data analysis and reporting using a command-line interface.
- Supports querying ad accounts, organizations, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, audiences, and lead forms.
- Enables performance analytics with pivot breakdowns, date filtering, and custom metric selection.
- Includes entity hierarchy guidance, authentication setup instructions, and sample CLI commands.
- Returns data in JSON with options for pagination and filtering.
- Useful for checking ad performance, structures, creatives, audience insights, lead submissions, and budget forecasts.
